Frequently Asked Questions

What is your primary area of practice?

We specialize in Criminal Defense, Matrimonial Disputes (Divorce, Alimony), Property Litigation, and Cheque Bounce (NI Act) cases across District Courts and High Courts.

How can I book a consultation?

You can book a consultation by clicking the 'Consult Now' button in the header, calling us directly at +917409296786, or visiting our office in Roorkee.

Do you handle cases in the High Court?

Yes, we represent clients in the High Court of Uttarakhand (Nainital), High Court of Uttar Pradesh (Prayagraj), and the High Court of Delhi.
